acceptance_criteria.statement: requestedModelClass accepts only primitive strings exactly equal to local or cloud and rejects all other types and values with controlled PolicyError.
Selection precedence remains requestContext.modelClass, then pack.modelPolicy.default, then local fallback, with validation before approval logic.
Cloud/private-data approval behavior is preserved and invalid values cannot bypass or enter approval decisions.
Tests cover both sources, fallback, precedence, accepted values, invalid types, empty/unknown/case-variant values, and existing regressions.
Only src/core/policy.js and test/policy.test.js change; npm test and git diff --check pass without dependencies or external changes.
